policies.title: Marshall Islands residual prior-visa requirement
policies.summary: The current Embassy page expressly requires citizens outside its exemption and arrival groups to obtain a visa before travel, while its linked Immigration schedule enumerates those groups.
conditions: Applies to ordinary-passport short visitors whose exact country is outside the current official exemption and arrival schedules.
The application must be lodged while the applicant is outside the Marshall Islands; admission and other entry requirements remain discretionary.
Guatemala is excluded because the official schedule lists it in both the visa-exempt and visa-on-arrival sections.
Hong Kong and Macao are excluded because the country-based residual rule does not directly resolve their separate SAR passport documents.

unresolved.reason: The same current official summary names Guatemala in both the ordinary-passport visa-exempt section and the visa-on-arrival section, so issuance timing is internally contradictory.
The current schedule and country-based residual rule do not directly classify the separate Hong Kong SAR passport document; no PRC nationality inference is made.
The current schedule and country-based residual rule do not directly classify the separate Macao SAR passport document; no PRC nationality inference is made.
